description: Every Hyperliquid wallet ranked by realized PnL, biggest losses or volume over a window. Wallets with fewer than 5 fills in the window are left out.

from.description: Window start: Unix ms or seconds, or ISO 8601 (2026-10-01T00:00:00Z). Default 30 days ago

to.description: Window end: Unix ms or seconds, or ISO 8601 (2026-10-01T00:00:00Z). Default now

name: get_pnl_leaderboard

max_drawdown_pct.description: Largest peak-to-trough drop of the PnL curve, 0 to 1

pct_maker.description: Share of fills as maker, 0 to 1

win_rate.description: Share of closed trades that were profitable, 0 to 1

notice.description: Present when the API added a note: how a market name was read, that data starts later than asked because of the history window, or a next step such as a free key

title: PnL leaderboard
